_what_this_is: The target FPGA platform. Every figure here was MEASURED or is a published part specification. Nothing here is produced by this package.
_source: The project's own hardware plan, which records a yosys synthesis run against this part and a cycle count from the Verilog testbench.

built_design._source: yosys, against XC7Z020, for the existing 8x8 build
built_design._utilisation_note: Measured in the Verilog testbench. The schedule is 8 weight-load cycles then 16 compute cycles, so its own ideal is 66.7 per cent and it achieves 60.1 per cent of the array.

deadlines._note: 33.3 ms is one frame at 30 fps. 16 ms is the budget the control loop allows for perception.
